thread.title: Clawson Park tennis courts closed for safety, new construction planned

author: J. N. Kern
title: Clawson Park tennis courts closed for safety, new construction planned
text:
The township announced on June 10 that the tennis courts at Clawson Park are now closed effective immediately due to unsafe surface conditions. The closure follows an inspection by the township’s insurance risk manager, who recommended shutting down the facility for resident safety.
According to officials, construction of brand-new tennis courts is scheduled to begin in the coming weeks. The township thanked residents for their patience and understanding as work proceeds on providing a safer and improved facility.
“We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to provide a safer and improved facility for our community,” officials said in a statement.
The township said it looks forward to reopening the courts once the project is complete and thanked residents for their cooperation during this period.
